name: 万事万象无常牌 Deck of Many More Things (BMT)

description.value:
奇物，传说

自万象无常牌被创造以来的几个世纪里，许多人都想过复制它却失败了。但有些人创造了新的卡牌。这44张新增的卡牌被统称为万事万象无常牌。（关于为这一牌组创建新卡牌的更多信息见第2章。）

就像万象无常牌一样，万事万象无常牌在诸多世界有着不同的显现。它可能会包含更多或是更少的卡牌，并且经常会和万象无常牌一起作为一套合并的66张牌的牌组出现。这套组合牌组通常由一个盒子或小袋子保护。万事万象无常牌的44张牌与万象无常牌相似，并具有强大的魔法效果，这将在后面的描述中详细说明。值得注意的是，来自万事万象无常牌

的卡牌更有可能是有益的，尽管其中大约三分之一仍然是危险的。

抽卡之前，你必须先声明要抽多少张卡牌，然后随机抽取。除非有某张卡允许你抽取额外的卡牌，否则继续抽取声明数量之外更多的卡牌将不会产生任何效应。

按正常方法抽出的卡牌其魔法效应在抽出时立即生效。你抽取两张卡牌之间的间隔不能超过1小时。除非有某张卡描述了例外情况，否则若你未能抽够声明数量的卡牌，声明了但是未抽取的那部分卡牌将从牌组中自行飞出并同时生效。

被抽出的卡牌其本身的存在将随之消散。除非你抽到的是愚者Fool或小丑Jester，否则抽出的卡型将重新出现在牌组里，使得你可能再次抽到该卡。

DM可以用万象无常牌套牌中提供的既存卡牌来构筑一副合并的万象无常牌和万事万象无常牌牌组。或者，在下方的万事万象无常牌表格中投掷来随机决定抽到了什么卡。

异怪Aberration。

你获得90尺心灵感应。

野兽Beast。

你立刻被变形为一只随机的cr5以下的野兽。你的游戏数据——包括你的属性、生命值，以及可用的动作......都被野兽的游戏数据所替换，你所穿着或携带的一切非魔法装备都融入你的新形态中无法使用。你所携带的一切魔法物品掉落在你新形态5尺内的未被占据空间中。你将以此法被变形持续[[/r 2d12]]天，当你处在此卡效果影响下时，没有任何事物能够改变你的形态，但@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.xjn6gjItpWpldE53]{祈愿术 Wish}可以提早结束变形。当你恢复你的正常形态后，你恢复到你被变形时原本的数据。

书籍Book。

你获得说、读、写[[/r 1d6 + 2]]种你所选的语言的能力。

桥梁Bridge。

你获得可施展法术@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.5V761kP78QMdqJpc]{时间停止 Time Stop} [[/r 1d3]]次的能力。使用你的智力、感知、或魅力作为施法属性（由你选择）。

篝火Campfire。

你立刻获得完成一次长休的好处。

洞窟Cavern。

你获得等同于你步行速度的攀爬速度。你也获得在垂直表面上下移动，以及倒挂在天花板上而无需占用你的双手的能力。

天界Celestial。

你从背上长出一对柔和发光的羽毛翅膀，获得30尺的飞行速度。

构装Construct。

一只@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.monsterspack.Actor.ZQTCZfTV9ZoTjNCU]{造妖Homunculus} 出现在你身旁5尺内，其外貌由dm决定，它将你认作它的创造者。

尸体Corpse。

你的生命值立刻变为0，并陷入昏迷&Reference[condition=unconscious]，必须立刻开始进行死亡豁免，法术和其他能够恢复生命值的魔法效果对你无效直到你伤势稳定。如果你死亡豁免失败3次，你将死亡并且只能被@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.xjn6gjItpWpldE53]{祈愿术 Wish}复活。

岔路Crossroads。

投掷一枚[[/r d20]]，如果是偶数，你的年龄增加[[/r 1d10]]岁，如果是奇数，你变得年轻[[/r 1d10]]岁，最小变为1岁。这个效应只能被@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.xjn6gjItpWpldE53]{祈愿术 Wish}，神圣干预，或是类似的魔法效应取消。

门扉Door。

你获得可施展法术@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.bJdmgHYyhUJv8Zyc]{异界之门 Gate} [[/r 1d4]]次的能力，无需材料成分。使用你的智力，感知或魅力作为施法属性（由你选择）。

龙类Dragon。

一颗龙蛋出现在你的脚下并立即孵化为一只雏龙。龙的类型由dm选择。它会认你为父母并且坚定地忠于你和你的盟友。

元素Elemental。

你获得以下伤害类型之一的免疫（在抽到卡后立即选择）：强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电、雷鸣。

专家Expert。

你的敏捷属性值+2，最高22。

妖精Fey。

一道通往妖精荒野的通道在你面前打开，并立刻将你拽入其中，在一道虹彩色闪光中消失。你停止抽卡。妖精荒野通道呈现为牌组上方闪亮的分形图案光芒，它会在卡牌被抽取后持续开放一分钟，该通道前往的妖精荒野中的具体位置由DM决定。

邪魔Fiend。

一个强大的邪魔出现在附近的一个无人占据的空间，并向你发起一次交易。这笔交易的确切性质取决于DM，但通常这个邪魔会提供一些物质奖励，以换取你和你的盟友完成它的任务。邪魔对你漠不关心，可以被讨价还价；它在其所做的任何交易中坚持自己的立场，尽管它可能会扭曲任何协议的措辞以符合它的目的。如果受到攻击，或者谈判失败而你拒绝了它的提议，它就会回到它的家园位面。

巨人Giant。

你立刻长高[[/r 2d10]]寸，你的当前生命值及其上限都提升20。

类人Humanoid。

抽到这张卡后，你可以立刻停下抽卡，不论你之前宣言要抽多少卡。

锐矛Lance。

你的所有属性值+1。最高20。

法师Mage。

你的智力属性值+2，最高22。

地图Map。

在你抽到这张卡后的一年以内的任何时间，你可以在心中指名你熟悉的一件物品、一个人的名字或是描述它。你立刻知晓其位置，以及你们之间的距离，即便它在不同的存在位面。如果你指名一个人，你知晓它是否或者以及它的状态。如果你指名一个物件，你知道它是否损坏。如果你指名一件具有充能的魔法物品，你知道它还剩下多少充能。

迷宫Maze。

你获得[[/r 1d3]]级力竭&Reference[condition=exhaustion]。

矿坑Mine。

一堆总计[[/r 2d6]]颗的宝石（每颗价值5000gp）以及[[/r 1d10]]块贵重矿石（每块价值2500gp）出现在你的脚边。

怪兽Monstrosity。

一只CR10或更低（由DM选择）的大型或更大的怪兽出现在你身旁15尺内。这个生物与你敌对并且立刻向你发起攻击。该生物被杀死或者你的生命值被减少到0时消失。如果没有足够的空间供它出现，这张卡牌没有效果。

泥怪Ooze。

一只@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.monsterspack.Actor.3fzQVYQhXxCXRa2o]{胶质方块Gelatinous Cube} 立刻出现在你的位置上并将你包裹起来。胶质方块是敌对的并且持续存在直到被摧毁。如果没有足够的空间供它出现，这张卡牌没有效果。

路途Path。

你的步行速度增加10尺。

坑陷Pit。

你脚下出现一个坑陷，你下坠[[/damage 3d6 * 10]]{3d6 × 10}尺，受到坠落伤害，并且倒地&Reference[condition=prone]。

植物Plant。

你获得无需法术位施展@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.n61LzTyqnbhiYxre]{植物交谈 Speak with Plants}的能力。每次长休只能使用一次。如果你具有3环以上法术位，你也可以用它们施展这个法术。使用你的智力，感知或魅力作为施法属性（由你选择）。

祭司Priest。

你的感知属性值+2，最高22。

囚犯Prisoner。

由魔法力场构成的发光锁链出现并缠绕上了你。你陷入 束缚&Reference[condition=restrained] 状态直到锁链被摧毁或你被释放。当你处于此状态下，你无法施展法术，你所穿着和携带的所有魔法物品的效应被压制。你停止抽卡。锁链对伤害免疫，无法被@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.as6xgBANCbyoWPXX]{解除魔法 Dispel Magic}或类似魔法效应解除。但@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.j4LqpyfXhYoUpUCz]{解离术 Disintegrate}会立刻摧毁锁链并释放你。其他生物也可以尝试用@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.itempack.Item.F8C51FA868C3F758]{盗贼工具 Thieves’ Tools}以一次[[/save ability=dex dc=30]]检定来释放你。

戒指Ring。

一枚珍稀以上稀有度的魔法戒指（由DM选择）出现在你的手指上。如果你有可用的同调位，你在它出现时自动与其完成同调。

盾牌Shield。

一套珍稀以上稀有度的你具有熟练的魔法护甲（由DM选择）出现在你的手上。如果你没有任何护甲熟练，当你未穿戴护甲时你的基础AC变为12+你的敏捷调整值。

船舶Ship。

你获得三项技能的熟练项（由DM选择）。

法杖Staff。

一根珍稀以上稀有度的法杖、权杖、或魔杖（由DM选择）出现在你的手上。

阶梯Stairway。

你可以选择减少2张宣言要抽的卡数量，或是获得一个珍稀以上稀有度的奇物（由DM选择）出现在你的手上。

雕塑Statue。

你立刻陷入 石化&Reference[condition=petrified] 状态，你的身体被转化为大理石。石化状态持续直到你被一道@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.7dqplcsKNYQgRh2S]{高等复原术 Greater Restoration}或类似魔法效应释放。

酒馆Tavern。

你的魅力属性值+2，最高22。

庙宇Temple。

某个神明或是具有类似力量的实体变得必须帮助你。从你抽到这张卡牌后到你死亡时的任意时间点，你可以以一个动作呼唤这个实体以求它的神圣干预，实体必定会响应。此次神圣干预的范围和效应（parameters and nature）由DM决定，如果你在使用神圣干预前死亡，祂会通过对你施展@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.PLsEzUel26T6JUTO]{复生术 Resurrection} 来完成其义务。一旦实体以神圣干预回应了你的呼唤或是复生了你，其不再必须帮助你。

墓穴Tomb。

在你抽到卡牌后一年内的任意时间，你可以施展一次法术@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.Nd9TfWfwNL9Wk5Yg]{完全复生术 True Resurrection}，无需法术位和材料成分。使用你的智力、感知、或魅力作为施法属性（由你选择）。

塔楼Tower。

你额外抽2张卡。这两张卡牌的效应不会立即生效，作为替代，你选择保留其中一张卡牌，另一张返回牌组。此后，你所保留的那张卡牌的效应立刻生效。

古树Tree。

你的皮肤变得如树皮一般粗糙。当你未穿戴护甲时你的基础AC变为15+你的敏捷调整值，但你具有火焰伤害的易伤。此转化可以被@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.xjn6gjItpWpldE53]{祈愿术 Wish}，神圣干预或是类似魔法效应取消。

亡灵Undead。

一个 还魂尸@UUID[Actor.bCp7pcBQawOYvZs3]{Revenant (MM'14)}在物质位面的某处被唤起。这个还魂尸将它的存在归咎于你并且不屈不挠地猎杀你来完成它的复仇。这个还魂尸存在1年，若它杀死了你他将提前消失。使用@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.xjn6gjItpWpldE53]{祈愿术 Wish}可以将其永久放逐到来世。

武者Warrior。

你的力量属性值+2，最高22。

水井Well。

你习得任意法术列表的3个戏法。（译注：没说施法属性是什么。）

Over the centuries since the first Deck of Many Things was created, many have sought and failed to replicate it. But some have created new cards. These forty-four additional cards are known collectively as the Deck of Many More Things. (More information on creating new cards for this deck appears in chapter 2.)

Like the Deck of Many Things, the Deck of Many More Things manifests differently on various worlds. While it can include fewer or different cards, it frequently appears with a Deck of Many Things as part of a combined deck of sixty-six illuminated cards. The combined deck is usually protected by a box or pouch. The forty-four cards of the Deck of Many More Things bear similar imagery to those in the Deck of Many Things and have potent magical effects, which are detailed later in this description. Notably, cards from the Deck of Many More Things are more likely to be beneficial, though about a third of them are still dangerous.

Before you draw a card, you must declare how many cards you intend to draw and then draw them randomly. Unless a card allows you to draw additional cards, any cards drawn exceeding this number have no effect.

As soon as you draw a card, its magic takes effect. You must draw each card you declared no more than 1 hour after the previous draw. Unless a card states otherwise, if you fail to draw the chosen number, the remaining number of cards fly from the deck and take effect simultaneously.

Unless it is the Fool or the Jester card, a drawn card immediately takes effect, fades from existence, and reappears in the deck, making it possible to draw the same card multiple times.

The DM can use the physical cards provided in The Deck of Many Things card set to build a combined Deck of Many Things and Deck of Many More Things, including whichever cards they desire. Alternatively, roll on the Deck of Many More Things table below to randomly determine what cards are drawn.

* Found in the @item[Deck of Many Things] as depicted in the Dungeon Master's Guide

Aberration. You gain telepathy within a range of 90 feet.

Beast. You immediately transform into a random Beast with a CR of 5 or lower. Your game statistics—including your ability scores, hit points, and possible actions—are replaced by the Beast's game statistics, and any nonmagical equipment you're wearing or carrying melds into your new form and can't be used. Any magic items you're carrying drop in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of your new form.

You remain transformed in this way for [[/r 2d12]] days; nothing can alter your form while you're under the effects of this card, but the @spell[Wish] spell can end the transformation early. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the same state you were in when you initially transformed.

Book. You gain the ability to speak, read, and write [[/r 1d6 + 2]] languages of your choice.

Bridge. You gain the ability to cast the @spell[Time Stop] spell [[/r 1d3]] times. Use your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability (your choice).

Campfire. You immediately gain the benefits of finishing a long rest.

Cavern. You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. You also gain the ability to move up, down, across vertical surfaces, and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

Celestial. You sprout a pair of softly luminescent, feathered wings from your back and gain a flying speed of 30 feet.

Construct. A @creature[homunculus] appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. The appearance of the homunculus is determined by the DM, and the homunculus treats you as its creator.

Corpse. You immediately drop to 0 hit points, have the &Reference[condition=unconscious] condition, and must begin making death saving throws. Spells and other magical effects that restore hit points have no effect on you until you are stabilized. If you fail three death saving throws, you die and can be resurrected only by the @spell[Wish] spell.

Crossroads. Roll a [[/r d20]]. If the roll is even, you age [[/r 1d10]] years. If the roll is odd, you become younger by [[/r 1d10]] years, to a minimum of 1 year. This effect can be undone only by the @spell[Wish] spell, divine intervention, or similar magic.

Door. You gain the ability to cast the @spell[Gate] spell [[/r 1d4]] times, requiring no material components. Use your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability (your choice).

Dragon. A dragon egg appears at your feet and immediately hatches into a dragon wyrmling. The type of dragon is chosen by the DM. The wyrmling views you as its parent and is staunchly loyal to you and your allies.

Elemental. You become immune to one of the following damage types (choose immediately upon drawing this card): acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

Expert. Your Dexterity score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22.

Fey. A fey crossing opens into the Feywild, and you're immediately pulled through it, disappearing in a flash of rainbow-colored light. You draw no more cards.

The fey crossing appears as a shimmering fractal of light above the deck, and it remains open for 1 minute after the card is drawn. The precise location in the Feywild to which the fey crossing leads is determined by the DM.

Fiend. A powerful Fiend appears in a nearby unoccupied space and offers you a deal. The precise nature of this deal is up to the DM, but usually the Fiend offers some material reward in exchange for you and your allies completing a task for the Fiend. The Fiend is indifferent to you and can be bargained with; it keeps its side of any bargain it makes, though it might twist the wording of any agreement to suit its purposes. If attacked, or if negotiations fail and you refuse the Fiend's offer, it returns to its home plane.

Giant. You immediately grow [[/r 2d10]] inches in height, and your hit point maximum and current hit points both increase by 20.

Humanoid. You can immediately choose to stop drawing from the deck, regardless of how many cards you initially declared.

Lance. All your ability scores increase by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Mage. Your Intelligence score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22.

Map. At any time you choose within 1 year of drawing this card, you can mentally name or describe an object or individual that is familiar to you. You immediately know the location of the object or individual, as well as the distance between you and the object or individual, even if the object or individual is on a different plane of existence. If you named an individual, you know if they are alive and any conditions they have. If you named an object, you know if it is broken or not. If you named a magic item that has charges, you know how many charges it has remaining.

Maze. You gain [[/r 1d3]] levels of &Reference[condition=exhaustion].

Mine. A pile of [[/r 2d6]] gems (each worth 5,000 gp) and [[/r 1d10]] chunks of precious ore (each worth 2,500 gp) appears at your feet.

Monstrosity. A Large or larger Monstrosity with a challenge rating of 10 or less (chosen by the DM) appears in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of you. The creature is hostile toward you and attacks immediately. The creature disappears when it is killed or when you are reduced to 0 hit points. If there isn't enough space for a Large or larger creature to appear, this card has no effect.

Ooze. A @creature[gelatinous cube] immediately appears in your space and engulfs you. The gelatinous cube is hostile and remains until it is destroyed. If there isn't enough space for the gelatinous cube to appear, this card has no effect.

Path. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet.

Pit. A pit opens beneath you. You plummet [[/damage 3d6 * 10]]{3d6 × 10} feet, take damage from the fall, and have the &Reference[condition=prone] condition.

Plant. You gain the ability to cast @spell[Speak with Plants] without using a spell slot; you must finish a long rest before you can cast it this way again. If you have spell slots of 3rd level or higher, you can cast this spell using them. Use your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability (your choice).

Priest. Your Wisdom score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22.

Prisoner. Glowing chains made of magical force appear and wrap around you. You have the &Reference[condition=restrained] condition until the chains are destroyed or you are freed. While you have this condition, you can't cast spells, and any magic items you're wearing or carrying have their properties suppressed. You draw no more cards. The chains are immune to damage and can't be dispelled using the @spell[Dispel Magic] spell or similar magic. However, a @spell[Disintegrate] spell destroys the chains instantly, freeing you. Another creature can also free you by succeeding on a [[/save ability=dex dc=30]] check using @item[thieves' tools|PHB].

Ring. A rare or rarer magic ring appears on your finger. If you have the attunement slots available, you're automatically attuned to the ring when it appears. The DM chooses the ring.

Shield. A rare or rarer suit of magic armor that you are proficient with appears in your hands. The DM chooses the armor. If you lack proficiency with any armor, your base AC instead now equals 12 + your Dexterity modifier while you aren't wearing armor.

Ship. You gain proficiency in three skills chosen by the DM.

Staff. A rare or rarer magic rod, staff, or wand appears in your hands. The DM chooses the item.

Stairway. You can choose to either decrease your number of declared draws by two or receive a rare or rarer wondrous item, which appears in your hands. The DM chooses the item.

Statue. You immediately have the &Reference[condition=petrified] condition as your body is transformed into marble. The petrification lasts until you are freed with the @spell[Greater Restoration] spell or similar magic.

Tavern. Your Charisma score increases by 2 to a maximum of 22.

Temple. A deity or entity of similar power becomes bound to aid you. At any point in time between drawing the card and when you die, you can use your action to call on this entity for divine intervention, and the entity is bound to answer. The parameters and nature of this intervention are chosen by the DM. If you die without having used this intervention, the deity fulfills its obligation by casting the @spell[Resurrection] spell on you. Once the entity has answered your call for divine intervention or resurrected you, the entity is no longer bound to aid you.

Tomb. At any time you choose within 1 year of drawing this card, you can cast the @spell[True Resurrection] spell once without expending a spell slot or requiring material components. Use your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability (your choice).

Tower. Draw two additional cards beyond your declared number of draws. The magic of these cards doesn't immediately take effect; instead, choose one of the two additional cards to keep, returning the other to the deck. The magic of the card you keep takes effect immediately thereafter.

Tree. Your skin immediately becomes rough, like tree bark. Your base AC now equals 15 + your Dexterity modifier while you aren't wearing armor, but you have vulnerability to fire damage. This transformation can be undone only by the @spell[Wish] spell, divine intervention, or similar magic.

Undead. Somewhere on the Material Plane, a @creature[revenant] rises. This revenant blames you for its existence and relentlessly hunts you to exact its revenge. The revenant exists until either 1 year passes, the revenant kills you, or you use a @spell[Wish] spell to banish it permanently to the afterlife.

Warrior. Your Strength score increases by 2 to a maximum of 22.

Well. You learn three cantrips of your choice from any spell list.
